text:
ara: quick check on bulk-revoke UX and the empty state when the last team-shared key is removed. posted mock for bulk selection + confirm modal. need copy + a11y + whether to require typed confirmation for shared keys.

ara: Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/YYYY/bulk-revoke (bulk modal v1)

toni: use-case: team lead wants to rotate compromised key used across envs. they may select 6 keys and hit Revoke. do we allow multi-select revoke with single confirmation? or require per-key confirmations for shared keys?

sam: security first: if any selected key is "shared/team" type, require an extra confirmation step. options: simple checkbox "I understand this will affect services" vs strong confirm (type the word REVOKE or key name).

lee: accessibility: typed-confirmation is problematic for keyboard-only + screen reader users, but it's stronger. If we use typed confirm, ensure the input is labelled, has autocomplete=off, and there's a clear error message. Also offer an alternative: a voice/text accessible pattern (we can rely on typing).

maya: preference: checkbox for multi-revoke, typed confirmation only for single shared key when it's the last key for a project (dangerous edge). Example: if user is revoking the last API key for project X, show modal that requires typing project slug to prevent accidental lockout.

ara: good nuance. Another related question: post-revoke empty state. If last key removed, the keys list switches to empty state. Should we show secondary CTAs: 'Create new key' primary and 'Contact admin' secondary? Also copy warning explaining app impact?

toni: copy suggestion for last-key-empty-state: short + actionable. Option A: "No API keys. Your services may stop working. Create a new key or re-enable a revoked key within 10s." Option B shorter: "No API keys. Create a new key to restore access."

sam: we should avoid scaring users unnecessarily. prefer Option B on-screen, but include a subtle inline banner that links to docs about best rotate practices.

lee: accessibility for empty state: make sure heading order is preserved (h1/h2), and the primary CTA is a real button element focused for keyboard users after the revoke flow if they land here. Use aria-describedby to connect impact details. For screen-reader users who come from revoke action, announce: 'Project X has no API keys. Create a new key.'

ara: what about Undo semantics in bulk revoke? we currently support undo for single revoke for 10s. implementing multi-undo raises race conditions. proposals:
- P1: allow a single bulk-undo that re-enables all keys selected (same 10s)
- P2: disable undo for bulk actions and show clear copy mentioning the lack of undo

maya: I'd prefer P1 but we need backend support for bulk snapshot and re-enable. If that's a blocker, P2 with clear copy is acceptable. Either way, include a conspicuous toast that lists number of keys revoked. e.g. '6 API keys revoked. Undo'

toni: backend note: we can snapshot multiple IDs in a single transaction and create a bulk-undo token. cost is minimal. Also audit logging should record per-key events. recommend P1.

sam: copy for bulk modal heading + body (short):
```
Revoke 6 API keys?
This will disable the selected keys immediately. Undo available for 10s.
```

sam: for shared keys warning (inline in modal):
```
Warning: one or more selected keys are shared with teammates and used in production. Revoking may cause downtime.
```

lee: accessibility nit: ensure that the warning is programmatically associated with the confirm button (aria-describedby referencing the warning id) so screen reader users get the caution before confirming.

ara: also debated whether bulk modal should be a center dialog or a bottom sheet on mobile. mobile: use full-screen sheet for clarity. desktop: centered modal. keep semantics consistent.

maya: another UI affordance: show a compact summary of affected environments (staging, prod) in the modal to help users decide. small pill list under the warning. keep it collapsed by default with 'show details' link.

lee: keyboard shortcut suggestion: when selecting via keyboard, once selection is non-empty, pressing 'r' opens revoke modal. ensure shortcut has tooltip and is discoverable. also must be disableable in settings.

ara: final design asks for the dev team:
- implement bulk snapshot + bulk-undo token (raj to confirm)
- modal copy as Sam's short version + shared-key warning snippet
- typed confirmation only when revoking last key for a project
- empty state with Create button focused after revoke if user lands there
- toast lists number revoked and includes Undo; toast focus behaviour same as single revoke (tabbable, polite aria-live)
- mobile modal becomes full-screen sheet

ops-bot: queued job #505: bulk-revoke-checklist for branch feature/bulk-revoke 10m.

ara: ok will update figma with the final copy and add a11y checklist. @lee please review the ARIA attributes when jin posts the prototype.

lee: will do. +1 on P1 (bulk-undo) if backend implements snapshot.

maya: +1 on copy and empty-state focus behavior.

sam: +1 on typed confirm only for last-key edge-case.

ara: thanks all, will post PR when mocks updated.
